summary: Lockheed Martin filed an 8-K to report entry into a new $2.25 billion 364-day unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing an existing one. The facility matures August 23, 2027, with an option to extend term loans for one additional year. No borrowings were made at closing. Interest rates are based on Base Rate or SOFR plus a margin tied to credit ratings; facility fee is 0.04%. Standard covenants, no financial maintenance covenant. This is a routine credit facility agreement, not a special situation.
